craft_notes: Sthāyin: old-bond-retired (invoke-feed-dismiss). Rows: row 2 (told→dismiss). Close: lifting (liṅgoddhāra as landing: the named rite closes). Rejected: 'absolution' — killed: kept no-harm (akiṃcitkara as the exact order); 'gods' plural — kept fire dismissed (agni singular).

lines: Then call the Vow-lord, worship, and by Śiva's word — 'harm none of his, thou' —
having told, fed, dismissed him, dismiss the fire. Thus the lifting of the liṅga.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato vrateśvaram āhūya pūjayitvā tasya śivājñayā akiṃcitkaraḥ tvam asya bhava iti śrāvaṇāṃ kṛtvā taṃ tarpayitvā visṛjya agniṃ visṛjet iti liṅgoddhāraḥ

reads_against.argmap: What happens to the old bond? → The old vow-lord is retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with the fire — thus liṅga-lifting.
c1_essence: Old vow-lord retired with honors: invoked, worshipped, ordered harmless, fed, dismissed with fire — thus liṅga-lifting.
